title: Tenma Saki — Brand New Style〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Humhumhuum♪
I'm gonna do my best again during practice today!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You seem to be in a good mood, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's because I am!
I am in a positively good mood today!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She isn't just in a good mood...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: She's on cloud nine.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, Ichi, did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We got our measurements back today and...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You guys gotta see this!
Check it out!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Y-You're not gonna believe this!
I grew a whole centimeter over this past year!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Wow...!
Congratulations, Saki. I'm so happy for you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thanks!
I've finally reached my goal of becoming 160 cm tall!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And that's not the only thing.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Shiiiho.
How tall are you again?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: How many times are you gonna make me do this? The same height as before. 159.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Which means!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Heehee! This means I'm officially more of a lady than you, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, what...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm not so sure about that...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.
I'm gonna keep getting taller and taller...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And I'm gonna become the most mature out of all of us!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I see...
That explains why she's acting the way she is.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm not sure growing in height has much to do with becoming more ladylike...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I don't think Saki's listening right now...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.
And if I keep growing at this rate...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ichi, you're next!
Get ready to go down!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, Ichika is technically next in terms of height...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But shouldn't you be striving to surpass Honami instead?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: B-But... Hona's way taller and way more ladylike than me... I don't think I'm ready to take on that sort of challenge yet...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
So, my next target is Ichi!
You're 161 cm tall, right?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Oh, but...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I also grew a little, so I'm 162 cm now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: W-Wait, what...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Looks like you couldn't close that gap.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sob*
B-B-B-B-B-B-But...
I was so close to becoming more ladylike than her!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Chin up, Saki. Don't worry...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I know you're sad about not outpacing her, but don't forget that you grew a whole centimeter this past year.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, I think you should be focusing more on celebrating your growth.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: L-Luka...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I agree.
Also, not everyone grows at the same rate.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, it's good to set goals for yourself like the one you just mentioned. However, if you're happy with your current results, I also think you should celebrate.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But if you wish to become even taller than you are now, Saki...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'll help you.
I can try looking for ways to make that happen.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
S-So bright...!
I'm gonna go blind...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I can see their auras!
They're so ladylike that they're wrapping us in love and warmth!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Doesn't this mean being “ladylike” isn't just about how tall you are...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Based on what I'm seeing, it's more important to be a source of comfort and support.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, I'm gonna try to become a tall lady with a heart of gold!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And I'm gonna surpass you three someday!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. And we'll give you all the support we can.
